Population decreased in Hastings

The estimated population of Hastings in 2024 was 91,219 usual residents.

This meant that Hastings was among one of only eleven local authorities in England and Wales where the population did not grow.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Hastings increased by 0.3%.

Over this slightly longer period, Hastings was also among the 20% slowest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Hastings

The average (median) age rose to 43.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Hastings has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Hastings is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Hastings' population of 91,219 usual residents was made up of:

  • 15,855 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.4%)
  • 56,145 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.5%)
  • 19,219 people aged 65 years and over, (21.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Hastings has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (21.1% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Hastings, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Hastings
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Hastings, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 259 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 800 births and 1,059 deaths in Hastings.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 329 (-0.4%). There were 4,833 people entering the area and 5,162 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Hastings' population of 584 (0.6%) as a result of 843 people entering the area and 259 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Hastings was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Hastings in mid-2023 is 91,221.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 337 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 67 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 404 people.
